description:
Universal search across all Noteboxd entities — fragrances, brands, notes, perfumers, and collections — in a single call. Best for quick lookups and vague queries.

Examples:
- "Jacques Polge" → returns the perfumer
- "oud" → returns the note, plus top oud fragrances
- "Bleu" → returns Bleu de Chanel, Bleu de Dior, etc.

See also: `fragrance_search` for advanced fragrance-only filtering (by note, decade, score, concentration) · `trending` for what's popular right now.

query.description: Search query — searches across fragrances, brands, notes, perfumers, collections

name: search
